name: signup-rest
description: PURE REST Notion signup — zero clicks, zero form automation. Replays the web client's own auth endpoints: getLoginOptions → sendTemporaryPassword → (code read DIRECTLY from the v3-mail worker inbox API with a Bearer token — no mail tab, no admin-cookie session) → loginWithEmail → session cookies captured. Email must be a NAMED priv.email alias (admin@/support@/noreply@/billing@/security@) so the code email dual-delivers into the v3-mail worker where this macro reads the body. The Notion-Client-Version header is read live from the signup page (it is REQUIRED — requests without it are rejected). Verified end-to-end 2026-08-25 (see docs/NOTION-REST-AUTH.md).

steps.function: (args) => { const t = (args.token || '').trim(); if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'emailWorkerToken input is empty — set it in the popup config panel (Email API token) or the macro inputs' }; if (/^(basic|bearer)\s+/i.test(t)) return { header: t }; try { return { header: 'Basic ' + btoa(t) }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'cannot build Authorization header (non-Latin1 token?): ' + e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const status = Number(args.status) || 0; if (status === 401 || status === 403) return { ok: false, error: 'mail API unauthorized (HTTP ' + status + ') — check the emailWorkerToken input (must be "Bearer <QUERY_API_TOKEN>")' }; const d = JSON.parse(args.body); const rows = d.results || []; let sinceId = 0; for (const r of rows) { const id = Number(r.id) || 0; if (id > sinceId) sinceId = id; } return { sinceId: sinceId, count: rows.length }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: 'mail baseline parse failed: ' + e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); const t = d.loginOptionsToken || ''; if (!t) return { ok: false, error: 'no loginOptionsToken in getLoginOptions response', body: (args.body || '').slice(0, 200) }; return { loginOptionsToken: t }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); const s = d.csrfState || ''; if (!s) return { ok: false, error: 'no csrfState in sendTemporaryPassword response (email may be rate-limited — wait and retry)', body: (args.body || '').slice(0, 200) }; return { state: s }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { try { const d = JSON.parse(args.body); if (d.error) return { ok: false, error: 'loginWithEmail failed: ' + JSON.stringify(d).slice(0, 200) }; return { isNewSignup: !!d.isNewSignup, userId: d.userId || '' }; } catch (e) { return { ok: false, error: e.message }; } }

(args) => { const cookies = args.cookies || []; const map = {}; for (const c of cookies) map[c.name] = c.value; return { userId: map.notion_user_id || '', tokenV2: map.token_v2 || '', deviceId: map.notion_device_id || '' }; }

steps.message: 🎉 REST signup complete — zero clicks, no mail tab
